reconciliation_policy.rule_1_addendum_corrections_override: Where the modern addendum states an explicit update/correction (Ramp upgrade, Brex era bounds, Rippling addition, Dropbox codification, Navan addition, Palantir negative flag, Toast Tier 1 era reconfirmation, post-2022 caveat block), that correction takes precedence.
reconciliation_policy.rule_2_tier_conflicts: Where the original whitelist and the research report assign different tiers to the same org-era, the unified tier is the average rounded to the nearest 0.5, rounding ambiguous quarters toward the weaker (higher-number) tier; both source grades are preserved in reconciliation_note.
reconciliation_policy.rule_3_era_windows: Era windows take the union of source windows; peak_window marks the strongest overlapping years.
reconciliation_policy.rule_4_grouped_entries: Source rows grouping multiple companies (e.g., 'Veritas / NetApp', 'Paycom / Paylocity') are split into separate records sharing the grouped rationale, flagged in reconciliation_note.

maintenance.versioning: Treat as a versioned data product, not institutional folklore. Log every tier or era change in the changelog.

changelog.changes: Initial unified synthesis of original whitelist + deep research report + modern addendum. 136 organization records, unified 1-3 tier scale with 0.5 midpoints, grit-filter and demand-capture flags, embedded scoring system, lineage graph.

core_principles.prior_not_verdict: Whitelist membership establishes a prior, not a verdict. Treat a whitelist hit as a reason to look closer, not to advance automatically - and treat absence as neutral, not disqualifying. Personal attainment, role difficulty, portability, and causal contribution must update the prior.
core_principles.logo_plus_era: The logo alone is not the signal - the logo plus the era is. Oracle 1994 and Oracle 2016 are different companies for talent assessment; Salesforce 2008 vs 2023 likewise.

org_points_cap.note: The whitelist should contribute no more than roughly 15-20% of an AE resume score; less for leaders. The org-era component can never by itself get a candidate above the bar.

core_principles.era_arc_theory: Sales-org quality follows an arc: too small/chaotic to train anyone early; a hypergrowth high-signal window (early PMF through a few years past IPO scale) with high bars, rigorous systems, real quotas and the best operators present and teaching; then scale brings overlay roles, territory fragmentation, softer accountability and brand-driven demand that flatters everyone's numbers. Windows target the high-signal arc; tenure mostly outside the window = evaluate the logo as generic.
core_principles.demand_capture_caution: Eras of overwhelming demand capture (Google Ads mid-2000s, OpenAI today) produce impressive attainment that says little about selling skill. Those orgs still screen for intelligence and polish - but verify the candidate ever had to CREATE demand rather than route it.
core_principles.missing_data_policy: U = unspecified in reliable public sources, never inferred and never converted to zero. Quota attainment, stage-normalized win rate, median deal size and internal stack adoption are generally undisclosed; move these to candidate/reference validation.
core_principles.product_vs_sales_quality: High-quality sales is separated from product quality: enormous organic demand can produce growth despite mediocre sales execution; an excellent sales org in a hard category may grow slower while producing better-trained sellers.
core_principles.hiring_model: P(candidate is excellent | resume) is proportional to P(individual evidence) x P(role difficulty) x P(organization-era quality) x P(skills transfer to target role) - NOT P(worked at famous logo).

inclusion_criteria.description: An org/era combination qualifies when most of the following were true during the window:

criteria.text: Hard to get into, so admission itself screened for something.
Formal onboarding, a named methodology actually enforced in deal reviews (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, PSS, Challenger, Sandler), active enablement.
Attainment measured honestly, underperformance had consequences, quotas set against a real market - not vanity numbers.
Reps had to beat credible alternatives, not just process inbound demand for a product that sold itself.
Meaningful outbound or expansion motion, so reps built pipeline rather than only receiving it.
Visible SDR -> AE -> senior segment -> leadership path; the org developed people rather than burning them.
Graduates went on to disproportionate success as AEs, VPs, CROs elsewhere - the strongest retrospective proof.

tier_definitions.scale_note: Unified numeric scale merging the original whitelist's Tier 1/2/3, the research report's Roman I/II/III, and the addendum's Arabic tiers. Split or conflicting ratings are encoded as midpoints (1.5, 2.5) per reconciliation policy.

1.label: Elite talent academy / canonical sales school
1.meaning: Selective intake, enforced methodology, honest quotas, competitive markets, famous alumni tree; unusually strong evidence of a repeatable commercial system and/or talent factory.
1.resume_interpretation: Era-overlapping tenure is strong positive signal on its own.

1.5.label: Elite/strong boundary
1.5.meaning: Tier 1 per at least one source or for specific segments/roles; Tier 2 per another lens (evidence confidence, overlay dilution).
1.5.resume_interpretation: Strong positive prior; validate segment, role and which source's caveat applies.

2.label: Strong professional org
2.meaning: Well-run machine with real training and accountability, but diluted by scale, brand tailwind, segment unevenness, or era-dependence.

2.5.label: Strong/contextual boundary
2.5.meaning: Credible org with material caveats (culture, attainment, decline, thin data).

3.label: Contextual / grit filter / demand-capture
3.meaning: Signal strongly depends on role, era or flags. Includes (a) GRIT FILTERS: high-volume, high-rejection environments (dialing floors, door-to-door, route sales, freight brokerage) that certify work ethic and resilience, not complex-sale craft; (b) contextual orgs where portability depends on role; (c) demand-capture environments.
3.resume_interpretation: Grit filters: great early-career signal - verify the skills upgraded afterward (Tier 3 stint then Tier 1/2 stint is a classically excellent trajectory). Others: small prior only; require strong individual evidence.

extra_states.gray: Quality <70 or evidence too weak - do not use logo as a positive signal.
extra_states.exclude_negative: Adverse evidence (quota design, churn, low productivity, weak process, toxic sales culture) - potential negative prior; see signal_flags.negative_signal.

formal_decision_rules.tier_1: Quality score >=85 AND evidence confidence >=70%, or extraordinary historical evidence across process/talent/outcomes.
formal_decision_rules.tier_2: Quality roughly 75-84 with >=60% confidence, or very strong role-specific evidence.
formal_decision_rules.tier_3: Good organization but evidence/portability strongly role- or era-dependent, or grit-filter environment.

signal_flag_definitions.grit_filter: High-volume, high-rejection environment certifying work ethic and resilience rather than complex-sale craft. Great early-career signal; distinguish thrivers (promotions, club, recruitment into better orgs) from mere survivors, and verify skills upgraded afterward.
signal_flag_definitions.plg_overlay: Product-led-growth company where sales overlays enormous inbound/expansion tailwind. Risk: AE harvested pre-qualified inbound rather than building pipeline. Apply scoring.plg_ai_rules.plg_overlay.
signal_flag_definitions.ai_demand_capture: 2023-2026 AI-era org where inbound demand is historically anomalous; 'sales' can mean order-taking and allocation. Apply scoring.plg_ai_rules.ai_demand_capture; reassess every 6-12 months.
signal_flag_definitions.demand_capture_era: Non-AI era of overwhelming demand capture (e.g., Google Ads mid-2000s, ZIRP-era hot categories). Elite intake screen and polish, but verify the candidate created demand rather than optimized/routed it.
signal_flag_definitions.negative_signal: Adverse sales-org evidence; the logo may be a negative prior for sales-skill assessment despite brand/stock success.
signal_flag_definitions.toxic_but_successful: Strong logo with churn-and-burn / culture caveats: may indicate resilience but may also mask inflated quota-miss records. Interview for what the rep actually controlled.
signal_flag_definitions.era_bounded: Whitelist credit is confined to the stated elite era; discount tenure beginning after the caveat date.
signal_flag_definitions.too_new: Org younger than ~3 years as a sales academy; unproven; cap credit and reassess.
signal_flag_definitions.not_a_sales_signal: Revenue outcome driven by concentrated mega-deals or non-repeatable dynamics; do not treat as a sales-machine signal.
signal_flag_definitions.thin_data_provisional: Tiered provisionally on thin independent sales-org data; validate before heavy weighting.
signal_flag_definitions.israeli_gtm_school: Member of the Israeli GTM school. Positive resume-lineage marker.
signal_flag_definitions.silicon_slopes_school: Member of the Utah Silicon Slopes outbound training-ground cluster. Recognizable pedigree; several members' current sentiment has declined.
signal_flag_definitions.mcmahon_lineage: Node in the PTC / John McMahon sales-system guild (MEDDIC / Command of the Message tradition). An unbroken chain of these logos in the right eras indicates a deliberately-trained operator from a coherent tradition - weight accordingly for AEs and leaders.
signal_flag_definitions.meddic_culture: Documented MEDDIC / Command-of-the-Message style qualification discipline.
signal_flag_definitions.outbound_academy: Documented intense outbound pipeline-generation discipline (a genuine skill-builder).

organization_era_quality_model.description: 12-criterion org-era scorecard, 100 total weight. Rate each observed criterion 0-5 (5 exceptional/verified, 4 clearly strong, 3 adequate, 2 mixed, 1 weak, 0 adverse, U unobserved - never convert U to zero). Normalize raw public metrics for era, segment, sales model, geography, scale, category maturity.

criteria.measure: Stage definitions, exit criteria, qualification, forecast cadence, account planning, manager inspection
criteria.strong: Documented methodology; repeatable operating cadence; measurable forecast discipline
criteria.failure_mode: 'We use MEDDICC' with little operational enforcement

criteria.measure: Median attainment; % fully ramped >=100%; % >=80%; distribution by cohort
criteria.strong: Broad attainment over multiple years, not merely a few stars

criteria.measure: Bookings/new ARR per ramped AE, gross-margin contribution, CAC efficiency, ramp duration
criteria.strong: Productivity stable or increasing as headcount scales
criteria.failure_mode: Growth entirely explained by adding headcount

criteria.measure: Onboarding depth, certification, role-play, coaching, recertification, manager development
criteria.strong: Formal sales school plus continuous coaching

criteria.measure: Multi-year organic growth, scale- and sector-adjusted
criteria.strong: Sustained growth across multiple cohorts/product cycles
criteria.failure_mode: Single boom year or acquisition-driven growth

criteria.measure: GRR, NRR, wallet retention, renewal, cross-sell/upsell
criteria.strong: High retention plus expansion rather than constant replacement
criteria.failure_mode: Fast new-logo growth covering high churn

criteria.measure: Win rate by stage, source, segment and competitive status
criteria.strong: Stable high-quality conversion with denominator discipline
criteria.failure_mode: Cherry-picking win rate after late qualification

criteria.measure: Stakeholders, technical proof, procurement, regulatory, implementation, channel coordination
criteria.failure_mode: Big ACV caused primarily by product pricing

criteria.measure: Internal promotions, alumni recruited into other elite GTM orgs
criteria.failure_mode: One charismatic CRO surrounded by weak managers

criteria.measure: Prefer median ACV plus P25/P75 to raw mean
criteria.strong: Meaningful economic stakes appropriate to target role
criteria.failure_mode: Equating higher ACV automatically with better selling

criteria.measure: CRM discipline, CPQ, enablement, intent/data, forecasting, conversation intelligence, usage telemetry
criteria.strong: Integrated system actually adopted by sellers

criteria.measure: Independent buyer, training or sales-talent recognition

organization_era_quality_model.evidence_confidence_formula: EvidenceConfidence = (sum of w_i for observed criteria) / 100
organization_era_quality_model.rationale: Process, attainment, productivity and training carry half the total weight - those factors best predict portable sales talent. Company growth gets only 10% because of survivorship/tailwind bias.

era_normalization.description: Sales-tech-stack maturity must be interpreted historically; stack maturity means integration and seller leverage, not more software.

eras.maturity_looks_like: Formal territory design, call planning, account records, quotas, sales schools, standardized selling skills, manager inspection
Structured CRM/SFA, pipeline stages, solution engineering, account planning, forecast hierarchy, formal methodology
Cloud CRM, marketing automation, SDR/AE specialization, customer success, enablement systems, increasingly quantitative RevOps
Integrated CRM/CPQ/data enrichment, conversation intelligence, product-usage telemetry, automated forecasting, customer health, omnichannel, AI-assisted workflows

nrr.note: Screening heuristics, not constants; retention varies systematically by ACV - normalize by segment. High native expansion (120%+) means testing seller causality MORE aggressively.

quantitative_heuristics.quota_dataset_ideal: fully-ramped seller count -> median attainment -> % >=100% -> % >=80% -> P25/P75 -> voluntary attrition. Never use average attainment alone (a few 250% performers conceal unhealthy distributions).
quantitative_heuristics.modern_tier1_benchmark: RepVue >=85 AND documented quota attainment >=50% AND evidence of self-sourced pipeline.
quantitative_heuristics.win_rate: Measure from a consistently defined stage; a 60% legal-stage win rate can indicate worse selling than 30% from qualified discovery. Score measurement quality and trend at least as heavily as the nominal percentage.
quantitative_heuristics.deal_size: Use median ACV + P25/P75 + cycle + stakeholders + new-logo/expansion mix + self-sourced %, never a raw average. Deal size gets low weight: a $20K greenfield cold deal can require more prospecting skill than a $1M brand-assisted renewal.
quantitative_heuristics.productivity_denominator: Fully ramped productive capacity, not total sales headcount: new ARR per ramped AE, bookings/AE, gross profit/AE, CAC ratio, time-to-ramp, pipeline per seller.

plg_overlay.risk: AE harvested pre-qualified inbound and expansion rather than building pipeline.
score_up_when: MEDDIC/MEDDPICC qualification of complex enterprise deals
score_down_or_neutral_when: Reads as inbound close rate, seat expansion, or renewal management only
plg_overlay.founding_leader_exception: Founding/early sales-leadership tenure at a PLG company (Parrish-type) is Tier 1 regardless - building the motion is the hard part.
plg_overlay.cap_rule: Without pipeline evidence, cap PLG-logo credit at Tier 2. Threshold to lift the cap: explicit outbound-sourced >=30-40% of pipeline, or founding/early-team status.

ai_demand_capture.context: 2023-2026 AI demand is historically anomalous - inbound so extreme that sales can mean order-taking and allocation.
weak_signal_examples: Cursor (sales-led revenue up 100x but org is months old)
CoreWeave (77% of revenue from 2 customers - concentrated mega-deal capture)
ai_demand_capture.guidance: Heavily discount 2023-2026 AI tenure unless the candidate demonstrably built pipeline/process; a name-brand AI logo alone is weak evidence of sales skill in this period. Reassess tiers every 6-12 months.

plg_ai_rules.fastest_to_100m_rule: Treat fastest-to-$100M-ARR claims as corroboration of org eliteness, not proof of individual skill; verify sourced pipeline, quota, Presidents Club. The ACV/customer-count profile matters: Wiz ($1M->$100M in 18 months, ~260 customers at $384K ACV, enterprise), Deel (20 months, 1,800 customers at $55K ACV, mid-market), Ramp (24 months, 5,000 customers at $20K ACV, SMB velocity) build different muscles.

dimensions.full_credit: 2-4 years of attainment, ideally 100%+ repeatedly; quota dollars given; rank/percentile; ramp periods separated
Exact high-quality era + relevant field segment + substantive tenure
ACV distribution, cycle length, stakeholders, technical/procurement complexity
Clearly separates self-created new business from renewal and natural expansion
Demonstrates qualification, account planning, forecast categories, stage discipline, methodology in actual behavior
Promotion, larger territories, enterprise moves, leadership assignments, Presidents Club with denominator
Numbers reconcile; quota, bookings, ARR, revenue, ACV used correctly; no vague percentile games

ae_rubric.worked_example: A candidate with Cisco 1998 but no quota numbers loses to a less-famous candidate with three years at 115%, 128%, 109%, strong self-sourced pipeline, relevant ACVs, credible references.

dimensions.full_credit: Median attainment, % at quota, P25/P75, multi-year improvement
Quality of hiring cohorts, time-to-productivity, internal promotions, regretted attrition
Forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, inspection system, manager coaching
Credible prior success as a seller, preferably in relevant motion
Segment, geography, ARR/bookings responsibility, manager span, channels
Balanced engine rather than bookings bought with churn or discounting
Learned and/or led inside a validated sales operating system
Promotions or repeated success at increasing scale
Precise team numbers that reconcile with company trajectory

sales_leader_rubric.system_vs_whale: 'My team hit 110%' is materially inferior to '62% of fully ramped reps hit quota; median attainment rose 78% -> 101%; new-hire ramp fell 9.2 -> 6.5 months; forecast error declined 31% -> 9%.' The second describes a sales system; the first might describe one whale.
sales_leader_rubric.build_vs_harvest: Era matters doubly for leaders: a VP who joined Snowflake in 2022 inherited a machine; one who built a region there in 2019 constructed it. Ask which. Also weight whether formative IC and first-line-manager years fall inside a whitelist window (where their model of how sales works was formed), and whether their alumni tree - people who followed them or whom they developed - shows up at quality orgs.

whitelist_credit_adjustments.situation: Exact Tier 1 era, directly quota-carrying target role, >=24 months fully ramped
Tier 1 company but adjacent era or somewhat different segment
Strong company, but <12 months or mostly ramping
Overlay/renewal/channel role when evaluating a new-logo AE
Inside/SMB role when evaluating a $500K+ strategic enterprise AE
Joined through acquisition but actually worked in predecessor organization
Lists famous acquirer after acquisition despite never working in its sales system
Prestigious company but no quota/output metrics
whitelist_credit_adjustments.credit_pct: org points may remain; performance points do not

whitelist_credit_adjustments.situation: Direct evidence candidate was below median despite elite company

tenure_rules.full_credit_months: 18-24+ months overlapping the window, fully ramped (sources: original whitelist 18-24+; research report >=24 fully ramped)
tenure_rules.tourist_stint: Under ~18 months inside a window usually means the candidate got the training but never proved durable attainment. One short stint is noise; a pattern of them is signal.
tenure_rules.time_at_risk: Twelve months of employment may be six months onboarding + three months territory formation + one quarter of actual selling. Do not credit like three full planning/quota cycles.

anti_signals.text: Tenure mostly outside the window means the brand reads as generic. Most common screening error: crediting 2021-era hiring-spree cohorts at 2015-era Tier 1 logos.
Big numbers where the product sold itself (Google Ads 2000s, ZIRP-era hot categories, OpenAI now) need deal-level probing: what did you outbound, what did you displace, what did you save?
Pattern of sub-18-month stints inside windows = signal (negative).
'VP Sales' at a 15-person 2021 startup often means senior AE with a title. Rebase titles to team size, quota owned, and hiring done.
At Tier 3 grinders, distinguish thrivers (promotions, club, recruitment into better orgs) from mere survivors.
Leaders who arrived after the machine was built: ask build vs harvest.

Flag Palantir, Verkada, ServiceTitan-style churn-and-burn explicitly: strong logos that may indicate resilience but may mask inflated quota-miss records; interview for what the rep actually controlled.

positive_patterns.text: A Tier 3 grit stint early plus a Tier 1/2 stint after is a classically excellent trajectory - grit certified, then craft installed.
Unbroken McMahon-guild (or similar school) chains in the right eras = deliberately-trained operator from a coherent tradition.
At least one 18-24+ month stint overlapping a Tier 1/2 window, promotion or segment progression inside it, and specific attainment claims (percentages, club years, rank).

interpretation_bands.recommendation: Weak-to-ambiguous; proceed only for unusually good role fit
Generally reject unless resume materially understates measurable performance

application_logic.overview: Deterministic pipeline an app should run per resume stint to produce the organization-era component of an AE or sales-leader score. This component is capped (see core_principles.org_points_cap) and must be combined with the individual-evidence rubrics in scoring.ae_rubric / scoring.sales_leader_rubric.

tier_base_credit_suggestion.note: Synthesis-derived STARTING multipliers mapping a resolved era tier to a fraction of the org-points budget, BEFORE credit adjustments, flag rules and tenure adjustments are applied. These are adjustable defaults, not values taken verbatim from either source.

pipeline.name: normalize_employer
pipeline.action: Map the resume's employer string to an organization id using organizations[].aliases first, then acquisition_and_alias_mappings.
pipeline.detail: If a mapping resolves map_to = null (Zenefits, Meraki, Slack), award ZERO org-era points but record a lineage_marker (see lineages) and, for acquisition strings, decide predecessor-vs-acquirer per the mapping rule. If no id is found, treat as gray (0 credit) - absence is neutral, never a penalty.

pipeline.name: resolve_era
pipeline.action: Among the org's eras, select the one whose [start, end] window overlaps the stint dates (end = null means present). Compute months_in_era from the overlap.
pipeline.detail: If the stint falls entirely AFTER the elite era on an era_bounded org, apply a heavy discount (treat as gray unless a later era record exists). If dates are unspecified on the resume, flag for candidate validation rather than assuming the best era.

pipeline.name: select_base_tier
pipeline.action: base_tier = era.tier. If role matches organizations[].role_tier_overrides (e.g., Figma sales_leadership = 1), use the override. Segment-conditional notes in the era rationale (e.g., Stripe enterprise arm, HubSpot enterprise vs velocity) require manual segment confirmation.
pipeline.detail: Split tiers 1.5 and 2.5 already encode 'strong for some segments/roles, weaker for others' - resolve toward the higher tier only with segment/role evidence.

pipeline.name: base_credit
pipeline.action: Look up tier_base_credit_suggestion.by_tier[base_tier] to get the starting multiplier.

pipeline.name: apply_flag_rules
pipeline.action: Adjust the multiplier based on organizations[].signal_flags, applied in this order:
rules: negative_signal -> set org-era credit to 0 and surface as a potential NEGATIVE prior (do not award logo credit); attach the negative-signal interview probe.
not_a_sales_signal -> set org-era credit to 0 (revenue driven by non-repeatable dynamics).

ai_demand_capture OR plg_overlay -> CAP the effective tier at 2 (multiplier <= 0.8) UNLESS the resume shows self-sourced/outbound pipeline >= 30-40%, net-new logo acquisition, or founding/early-team status (see scoring.plg_ai_rules). Founding/early sales-leadership tenure is exempt from the cap.
too_new -> cap multiplier at the Tier 2.5-3 range and set a reassessment flag (see meta.maintenance.reassessment_cadence).
era_bounded -> if the stint is within the elite era, no change; if outside, heavy discount per step 2.
toxic_but_successful -> no automatic change, but attach the 'what did the rep actually control' interview probe and weight quota-attainment evidence more heavily.
thin_data_provisional -> do not heavily weight; require candidate validation before treating as a strong positive.

israeli_gtm_school / silicon_slopes_school / meddic_culture / outbound_academy -> positive lineage/skill markers; do NOT inflate the numeric multiplier, but record as qualitative pedigree and route to matching interview probes.

pipeline.name: apply_credit_adjustments
pipeline.action: Apply the matching rule from scoring.whitelist_credit_adjustments using the role type, exact-era match, and evidence quality to refine the multiplier (e.g., exact Tier 1 era + quota-carrying role + adequate ramp = 100%; acquirer-listed-without-working-in-system = 0-25%; below-median individual evidence overrides the halo to 0).

pipeline.name: apply_tenure_adjustment
pipeline.action: Apply scoring.tenure_rules: >=18-24 months in the elite era earns full credit; sub-12-month 'tourist' stints are discounted (25-60%); account for time-at-risk / ramp before crediting quota outcomes.

pipeline.name: compute_points
pipeline.action: org_era_points = round(budget * final_multiplier), clamped to [0, budget], where budget = core_principles.org_points_cap.ae_points_of_100 (15) for AEs or sales_leader_points_of_100 (10) for leaders.
pipeline.detail: This is the ONLY contribution the whitelist makes. The remaining 85 (AE) or 90 (leader) points come from individual evidence, role difficulty, and skills-transfer per the rubrics. The org-era component can never by itself clear the hiring bar.

pipeline.name: emit_interview_probes
pipeline.action: Emit verification prompts from scoring.verification_checklist, prioritizing those keyed to the flags and caveats triggered above (PLG/AI -> self-sourced pipeline %; toxic_but_successful/negative_signal -> what the rep controlled; era_bounded -> what changed after the boundary; thin_data_provisional -> corroborating metrics).

worked_example.input: Resume stint: 'AE, TripActions, 2018-2021, 112% average quota attainment, 60% self-sourced pipeline'. Target role: Enterprise AE.
trace: Step 2: overlaps navan elite era 2017-2021 (pre-COVID); ~36 months in era (note 2020-2021 travel-shock caveat).
Step 3: base_tier = 2 (no leadership override for an AE).
Step 5: no capping flags (Navan is not PLG/AI/negative); era is in-window so era_bounded does not discount.
Step 6: exact Tier 2 era + quota-carrying role + strong self-sourced pipeline -> ~100% of the Tier 2 credit.
Step 9: probe the 2020-2021 COVID travel shock ('what changed, how did your number hold?') and verify the 60% self-sourced claim.
worked_example.reminder: 12/15 org-era points is a strong prior, not a hire. The 112% attainment and 60% self-sourced pipeline are scored separately in the AE rubric and are what actually move the decision.

data_caveats.repvue_scores: RepVue scores are self-reported, fluctuate monthly, and skew toward disgruntled reviewers. Use as a directional signal, not ground truth.
data_caveats.arr_and_growth_figures: Many ARR and 'fastest-to-$100M' figures come from company blogs, VC newsletters (Not Boring, SaaStr, Sacra) and podcasts - self-interested sources. Treat as approximate corroboration, not proof of individual skill.
data_caveats.thin_data_provisional: Several orgs (Adyen, Bill.com, Mercury, Personio, Abnormal Security, Arctic Wolf, Postman) had thin independent sales-org data in this pass and are tiered provisionally - see signal_flags.thin_data_provisional.
data_caveats.ai_cohort_time_sensitivity: AI-cohort tiers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, Sierra, Harvey, Glean, Clay) are the most time-sensitive; extreme inbound demand and rapid leadership churn (OpenAI cycled multiple CROs by August 2026) mean these should be re-assessed every 6-12 months.
data_caveats.scope_of_assessment: This asset assesses SALES-ORG QUALITY AS A RESUME SIGNAL, not company investment quality, product merit, or stock performance. A great stock (e.g., Palantir) can still be a weak or negative sales-skill signal.
data_caveats.geographic_and_language_bias: Underlying evidence has a meaningful US / English-language bias; SEC reporting makes US-listed companies disproportionately easy to validate. Non-US orgs may be under-covered rather than genuinely absent.
data_caveats.survivorship_bias: The list over-represents survivors and public companies. Absence from the whitelist is explicitly NEUTRAL, never a penalty (see core_principles).
data_caveats.biggest_evidence_gaps: Quota attainment distribution, stage-normalized win rate, median deal size, and internal sales-stack adoption are the least reliably public fields. These are the biggest gaps and should be moved from desk research to candidate self-report and reference validation.
data_caveats.missing_data_is_not_zero: Unspecified (U) values are never treated as zero and never silently substituted (e.g., do not fill a missing deal-size with a proxy). Uncertainty routes to validation, not to a numeric penalty.
